question: Which statement gives the details of the estimated revenue and expenditure of the government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annual Financial Statement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Annual Financial Statement (AFS) gives a comprehensive summary of the estimated revenue and expenditure of the government for a financial year.
 
• It is presented by the Finance Minister of India in Parliament, typically on the first day of February.
 
• The AFS is divided into three parts: the Consolidated Fund, the Contingency Fund, and the Public Account of India.
 
• This document includes estimates of expenditure and receipts for both the current and the upcoming fiscal years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Income Statement**

 
 
• An income statement, also known as a profit and loss statement, is a financial statement that shows a company's revenues and expenses during a particular period.
 
• It indicates how the revenues are transformed into the net income or net profit.
 
 
 
• **Balance Sheet**
 
 
• A balance sheet is a financial statement that provides a snapshot of a company's financial position at a specific point in time.
 
• It lists the company’s assets, liabilities, and shareholders' equity.
 
 
 
• **Balance of Payments**
 
 
• The balance of payments is a record of all economic transactions between the residents of a country and the rest of the world in a particular period.
 
• It includes the trade balance, foreign investments, and international aid.
